name: 03-oak-takes-you-to-the-lab
objective: Walk north out of Pallet Town into the tall grass at the top of the map. Oak's own map script fires the moment wYCoord reaches 1 and he ESCORTS you into his laboratory - the player does not walk there. So the goal is the flag his escort sets when it finishes, not arriving at a building.
evidence: watch:followed_oak_into_lab!=0 — EVENT_FOLLOWED_OAK_INTO_LAB, event index 0, so wEventFlags $D747 bit 0 (atlas, rom+live). Set by OaksLabFollowedOakScript (pokered scripts/OaksLab.asm) once the simulated PAD_UP x8 walk that Oak's escort performs has finished, i.e. inside the laboratory with the introduction under way. The trigger that starts it is PalletTownDefaultScript's `ld a,[wYCoord] / cp 1 ; is player near north exit?`, and the two tiles at x=10,11 on rows 0 and 1 of Pallet Town are tileset tile $52, the Overworld grass tile.
